title: Module comparison: original Mel Filter Bank and final SkewDCT branch

rows.original: Custom RTL first-order pre-emphasis and shift-register framing. A coefficient is assigned inside the module.
rows.current: Reworked custom RTL with parameterized Q15 pre-emphasis, previous accepted raw sample, signed arithmetic and PCM16 saturation.
rows.notes: Modified upstream stage. Sample history advances on accepted input. Frame output holds under backpressure. The input frame remains register-based.

rows.original: Custom RTL multiply with an embedded N-word cyclic coefficient register. Changing N requires regenerated source coefficients.
rows.current: Custom RTL Q14 window multiplication. A coefficient file supplies eight length-dependent rows, selected for N=16..2048.
rows.notes: Extended upstream window stage to all eight lengths and deterministic reload. Active coefficients still rotate in registers; this stage is not described as fully BRAM-based.

rows.original: RTL wrapper around XFFT IP and two mult_gen_0 multiplier IP instances. The packaged square multipliers have seven pipeline stages.
rows.current: Custom RTL FFT wrapper with registered real/imaginary squares, followed by a registered power sum and elastic ready/valid control.
rows.notes: Replaced instantiated multiplier IP with RTL arithmetic. Isolated multiplication from addition and aligned data, valid and last through stalls. DSP inference remains permitted.

rows.original: AMD/Xilinx XFFT IP, packaged as xfft_512. The supplied IP configuration is fixed at 512 points.
rows.current: Custom RTL 16-bit real input / 32-bit complex output facade for eight supported lengths, with full- or half-spectrum output.
rows.notes: The historical fft512 filename does not limit the new implementation to 512 points. MFCC selects N at elaboration; a separate standalone FFT top exposes runtime selection.

rows.module: Variable-length shared FFT tree and controller
rows.original: No exposed custom FFT tree. The XFFT configuration has runtime transform-length selection disabled.
rows.current: Custom RTL shared FFT16/FFT256 root families, radix-4 expansion and real-input doubling. The runtime top selects 16/32/64/128/256/512/1024/2048.
rows.notes: Added the shared configurable architecture and frame-local size capture. 16/32 are supported. AMD Radix-4 Burst I/O starts at 64; other XFFT architectures also support 16/32 [S2].

rows.module: FFT16 arithmetic root and constant rotations
rows.original: FFT arithmetic is internal to XFFT IP. No standalone FFT16 RTL root is provided in upstream.
rows.current: Integrated custom RTL FFT16 root, including fixed-angle arithmetic cells and registered datapaths.
rows.notes: Provides the small-root family and the arithmetic roots used inside FFT256. This is an RTL integration/adaptation contribution, not a claim that the FFT algorithm was invented here.

rows.original: No standalone FFT256 RTL root. Transform stages are implemented inside XFFT IP.
rows.current: Integrated two-pass FFT16-based FFT256 datapath, with transpose buffers, intermediate rotation, normalization and root configuration.
rows.notes: The large-root family is reused for 256/512/1024/2048 configurations. fft256_1024 is instantiated in its direct N=256 root mode by the final engine.

rows.original: No separately exposed RTL merge kernel. Butterflies and twiddle products are internal to XFFT IP.
rows.current: Custom RTL kernel sharing four real multiplier expressions across complex rotations and radix-2/radix-4 combination modes.
rows.notes: Product registers, rotation add/subtract stages and butterfly stages break up long multiply-add paths. Saturation and the defined shift/truncation order are retained.

rows.module: Real-input point doubling and spectrum reconstruction (fft2x / fft2)
rows.original: No custom real/imaginary packing and reconstruction module. Real data is supplied to the configured complex XFFT IP.
rows.current: Custom RTL cache, conjugate-pair split and radix-2 reconstruction around the shared complex FFT result.
rows.notes: One backend handles 32/128/512/2048 real-point extensions. BRAM caches replace frame-wide datapath buses, and the merge arithmetic is shared with radix-4 expansion.

rows.module: FFT input, lane and spectral-cache memories
rows.original: Memory is internal to XFFT IP. No equivalent project-level FFT buffer interface is exposed.
rows.current: Custom RTL synchronous one-write/one-read RAM template, instantiated for input, radix-4 lanes and reconstruction/output caches.
rows.notes: Explicit ports and read-latency scheduling replace large register arrays and wide indexed muxes in the developed FFT wrapper. Mirrored caches provide the required independent reads.

rows.original: No equivalent standalone transpose buffer. Storage and reordering are internal to XFFT IP.
rows.current: Integrated BUFRAM256C, RAM256 and RAM2x256C RTL buffers for the FFT256 root and its two FFT16 passes.
rows.notes: Explicit memory addressing and ping-pong ownership support the existing root timing. These root-local buffers are distinct from the larger FFT-tree caches.

rows.original: Scaling is part of XFFT IP. No custom CNORM module is exposed by the original project.
rows.current: Integrated custom RTL normalization between FFT256 passes, with configurable shifts, narrowing and overflow outputs.
rows.notes: Keeps fixed-point width management explicit in the RTL. This is a scaling/integration contribution, not an additional FFT transform or a vendor normalization IP.

rows.module: FFT twiddle lookup and root rotation
rows.original: Twiddle storage and rotation are internal to XFFT IP.
rows.current: Custom RTL WROM2048 coefficient lookup and root-local rotation, with stage-dependent phase addressing.
rows.notes: Coefficient contents are file-based and shared across supported lengths. Data buffers target BRAM; this does not imply that all coefficient ROMs are BRAM-mapped.

rows.original: 40 Mel outputs, a cyclic coefficient register, ascending/descending accumulation and one mult_gen_1 multiplier IP.
rows.current: Rewritten custom RTL 64-band sparse lookup. Each frequency-bin entry contains up to two band IDs and Q15 weights. Two 48-bit products feed 64-bit energy sums.
rows.notes: Replaced multiplier IP and coefficient rollover logic. Registered operand selection, products and accumulation align tags. Invalid-band sentinel 127 suppresses writes; short FFTs can leave empty bands.

rows.original: Custom dB_LUT uses a large combinational casex table and integer dB outputs. It is not an IP core.
rows.current: Custom RTL floor clamp, leading-one detection, normalized mantissa lookup in a 1024-entry Q20 ROM, exponent correction and Q8 output conversion.
rows.notes: Replaced the active integer lookup with tagged pipeline stages and size-aware energy scaling. Preserves the project convention 20*log10(energy). The old dB_LUT file is retained but inactive.

rows.original: Absent. The original top outputs Mel features directly without a DCT stage.
rows.current: Added custom RTL 64-point DCT-II pipeline coordinating the skew transform, normalization, ordinary DCT8 groups and C64 output processing.
rows.notes: Produces all 64 cepstral coefficients. Ready/valid serialization, coefficient indices and overflow reporting are integrated into MFCC. Transform factorization follows cited literature [S3].

rows.original: Absent. There is no DCT input permutation stage.
rows.current: Custom RTL 8x8 lane permutation with alternate row/column direction required by the skew decomposition.
rows.notes: Added structured input wiring. Despite the BUFRAM name, this implementation is combinational permutation, not a physical RAM and not an extra arithmetic core.

rows.module: SkewDCT8 time-shared bank and family selector
rows.original: Absent. No SkewDCT bank or skew-family interface is present.
rows.current: Custom RTL bank issues eight groups through one shared SkewDCT8 core and stores transposed results with return tags.
rows.notes: Replaces eight concurrently instantiated family cores with scheduled reuse. The recursive core receives a 3-bit family ID instead of a 64xCOEF_W coefficient bus.

rows.original: Absent. There is no custom or IP-based DCT core in the original project.
rows.current: Custom RTL 8-to-4-to-2 factorization for eight coefficient families, with Q21 constants, guard bits and a 13-stage tagged pipeline.
rows.notes: Replaces the developed dense 8x8 dot-product path in active mode. The recursive expression has 12 real products and 29 add/subtract operations. These arithmetic counts are not measured DSP counts.

rows.original: Absent. No DCT inter-stage width or scale management is needed upstream.
rows.current: Integrated custom RTL shift, narrowing, valid alignment and overflow checking after the skew and ordinary-DCT stages.
rows.notes: Makes fixed-point widths and scale boundaries explicit. Overflow information propagates to the complete DCT wrapper.

rows.original: Absent. No ordinary DCT8 bank is present.
rows.current: Custom RTL scheduler, tagged group issue, transpose storage and serialized result readout around one shared DCT8 core.
rows.notes: Reuses one arithmetic core across eight groups. Buffering and ready/valid control preserve group order while the core pipeline drains.

rows.original: Absent. No DCT8 arithmetic implementation is present.
rows.current: Custom RTL factorized butterflies and fixed-angle rotations with a nine-stage valid/tag pipeline.
rows.notes: Added registered multiplication and add/subtract boundaries to avoid long multiply-add chains. The existing stage-specific shifts and truncations are preserved.

rows.module: C64 output selection, compensation and post-add
rows.original: Absent. There is no DCT post-processing or cepstral output ordering stage.
rows.current: Custom RTL three-stage pipeline: indexed operand selection, optional compensation product, and final post-add/output.
rows.notes: Separates the former selection-to-multiply-to-add path. Index/valid/control are delayed together, and backpressure freezes all stages. This change enabled the supplied 150 MHz timing pass.

rows.original: Absent. The original project has no matrix-DCT reference backend.
rows.current: Optional custom RTL single-MAC 64x64 reference with a LUT coefficient ROM, input/output FF storage and separate operand/product/accumulator registers.
rows.notes: Comparison backend only; DCT_USE_MATRIX=0 keeps SkewDCT active. Register/LUT storage removes the BRAM-storage mismatch, while multiplier parallelism remains different.

rows.original: Custom RTL top connects input preparation, Hamming, power and Mel/log stages, then outputs 40 16-bit Mel features.
rows.current: Reworked mfcc / mfcc_core integration appends the selected DCT backend and assembles 64 coefficients, 26 bits each at default precision.
rows.notes: Extends the inherited stream architecture into a full MFCC chain. Compile-time N, precision parameters, output-lane configuration and end-to-end ready/valid are exposed.

rows.original: Custom RTL output packing for 40 16-bit Mel values, with OUT_WIDTH dividing 40.
rows.current: Adapted custom RTL packing for 64 DCT coefficients, parameterized word width and output lanes. A full 64-lane bypass is available.
rows.notes: Changed the output contract from Mel features to cepstral coefficients. Counter width, valid hold and last-word indication support the new frame format.

granularity: 26 functional groups, including one optional MatrixDCT reference; groups are not instance counts or claims of independent invention.
ip_note: Custom RTL means no packaged XFFT, DCT or multiplier IP in the production datapath; DSP/BRAM primitive inference is still allowed.
